header: Overview of pipeline features in Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion
content:
Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion provisions pipelines, which consist of a source, a buﬀer, zero or
more processors, and one or more sinks. Ingestion pipelines are powered by Data Prepper as the
data engine. For an overview of the various components of a pipeline, see the section called “Key
concepts”.
The following sections provide an overview of some of the most commonly used features in
Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion.
Note
This is not an exhaustive list of features that are available for pipelines. For comprehensive
documentation of all available pipeline functionality, see the Data Prepper documentation.
Note that OpenSearch Ingestion places some constraints on the plugins and options that
you can use. For more information, see the section called “Supported plugins and options”.
